description: TermTerm fast baseline checks; review and trust in Codex before automatic use.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$repo = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; & 'C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe' ($repo + '/.codex/hooks/check.sh'); exit $LASTEXITCODE"
